subject: Defining a custom theme (not modifying an existing theme)

messages.author: d994cff5897faec8
messages.subject: Defining a custom theme (not modifying an existing theme)
parts:
I have a whole bunch of plots all of which go

ggplot(...) + ... +
theme_bw() + opts(panel.border=theme_blank(),
axis.line=theme_segment(colour="black", size=0.2),
legend.key=theme_blank(),
legend.text.align=1)

How would I define a theme_thispaper() that was equivalent to the
above snippet? theme_update, theme_set, etc all seem to modify the
currently selected theme, I don't want that, I want to define a custom
theme without modifying any of the stock ones and then apply it to the
plots.

zw
